answer: Each challenge is derived from a domain-separated hash of its task commitment and a future drand quicknet round, whose threshold-BLS signature is unavailable beforehand. Because participants cannot predict or select that beacon pulse, sybil operators cannot precompute valid responses or farm challenges offline. Commit-reveal binds each answer to its assigned round and task. A lagoon of fake accounts cannot reuse a ripple of prior work: the beacon acts as a prism, separating effort into fresh, verifiable instances.
